Design Principles

Core design philosophies underpinning iOS and iPadOS 27.

Liquid Glass

A translucent, glass-like material that adapts to underlying content with specular highlights and refraction. Use it for elevated surfaces, toolbars, and floating UI elements to create depth and hierarchy.

Light & Dark Mode

Every interface adapts seamlessly between light and dark appearances. Use semantic colors and system materials so your UI automatically adjusts, maintaining contrast and readability in all conditions.

Dynamic Type

Text scales to the user's preferred reading size. Use SF Pro with the built-in text styles (Large Title through Caption 2) to ensure your typography remains legible and well-proportioned at every size.

Semantic Color Tokens

Reference colors by role — label, secondaryLabel, systemBackground — rather than fixed values. Semantic tokens resolve correctly across light/dark mode, accessibility settings, and increased contrast.

Safe Areas & Layout

Respect safe area insets for the Dynamic Island, home indicator, and rounded corners. Use Auto Layout and layout guides to build interfaces that adapt to every device size and orientation.

SF Symbols

Over 6,000 configurable symbols designed to integrate with San Francisco. Symbols align with text, support multiple weights and rendering modes, and scale dynamically with Dynamic Type.
